verdict.rationale: Expensify's first-party material describes a plain-language interface, 'Ask Expensify AI anything'. It covers operating the product: creating, categorizing, tagging, approving and rejecting expenses with no clicking. It covers configuring workspaces and rules, and fixing setup mistakes, 'by just asking'. It also covers querying spend and generating charts in natural language. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language commands work as claimed, and in-depth docs beyond a marketing blog post (e.g., limits, supported commands, availability by plan).
